title: Identity for a canonical etale section comparison
statement: For schemes R and S, a morphism f:S→R, a sheaf G of sets on the small etale site of R, and an etale object U over R, the section comparison [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison] for the commuting triangle S --id--> S --f--> R, with composite f, is the identity on sections of f inverse image G over the base change of U by f.

source.place: Tags 03CB and 03CC; explicit identity calculation for canonical section maps in the degree-zero application of Etale Cohomology Tag 09YQ

proof.text: Let F be the inverse image of G by f. Restriction along base change by the identity has the natural identity isomorphism pushId obtained from Functor.sheafPushforwardContinuousId' and MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackId. Let t be the chosen inverse-image composition component for (f,id), followed by equality transport along id_comp f. The identity adjunction unit followed by the identity pushforward of t and by pushId.hom defines a sheaf endomorphism p of F.

Apply injectivity of the f inverse-image adjunction homEquiv to compare p and the identity. Their images are unit_f followed by push_f applied to the endomorphisms. Evaluate at any etale object V and section s of G. The composition unit clause of etaleSetInverseImageCompositionUnits identifies c(unit_id(unit_f(s))) with restriction of unit_f(s) along the inverse fibre-product pasting. MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp_id_left identifies that pasting map with pullbackId.hom. Restriction along pullbackId.inv cancels it by functoriality, so the two adjunction transposes agree. This proves p = id without any local generation or sections-existence assumption.

Evaluate p = id at the base change of U by f. Unfold p and etaleSetSectionComparison. By MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp_id_left, the final restriction in the section comparison is exactly pushId.hom evaluated at that object. Equality transport along id_comp f reduces to the identity, and proof irrelevance identifies its witnesses. Thus the evaluated endomorphism is precisely the required section comparison.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03CB and 03CC: the adjunction-unit characterization of inverse image. The identity calculation uses the existing composition unit equation and injectivity of the f adjunction homEquiv; implemented and compiled on 2026-10-12.

Upstream upperStar identity/composition laws require abelian coefficients; Type-valued inverse images here need the separate calculation. No direct replacement found.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleSetSectionComparisonIdentity
    {R S : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ R)
    (G : Sheaf R.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (U : R.Etale) :
    etaleSetSectionComparison (𝟙 S) f f (Category.id_comp f) G U = 𝟙 _
